bridgeRouteRisk.summary: nWISDOM has reviewed native issuance on Ethereum, Plume, and BNB Chain. Solana is a LayerZero OFT mint/burn representation of Plume-issued shares, not an independent native liability issuer: the issuer's archived guide routes Solana USDC through CCTP to mint on Plume before OFT delivery. The Solana 1-of-2 SPL mint/freeze authority, OFTStore admin, and immediate program upgrade path are preserved here. Complete peers, DVNs, limits, recovery, key custody and runtime materiality remain unresolved; the aggregate tier remains provisional.

The Solana nWISDOM SPL mint 77DTSzxisdQWshFYHP9M2JBDuHNojLAVoC7GBNC2yadT carries only the standard SPL u64 bound (supply 2,910,340.262008, mintAuthority 9zXJ3JWM1HtUrjgkLstDnHyZjVLgpxeZGbET8cJoea9Y), and the LayerZero OFT store RgP5qMfX58PBLm6EoEgCfgfWxLdVBmGTm6bYnD3kECq decoded to oft_type 0 (native mint/burn) with default_fee_bps 0, paused false, and no cap field.
